fusions.name: Overland Ram
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to an enemy and ram it, which deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Gunwale Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out over the rail in a short arc ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Boots for the Portage
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Carried Over the Road
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 10%.
